/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/bismillahi-nur-e-khuda.md\")
original = path.read_bytes()
head, body = original.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
metadata, roman_bytes = head.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
roman = roman_bytes.decode()
fixes = {
    \"ain ul yaqin\": \"ain ul yaqiṅ\",
    \"  Ali Ali Ali Ali\\n\\n  Ae naazeman\": \"  Ali Ali Ali\\n\\n  Ae naazeman\",
    \"Har jaa Ali ka khuṅ baha\": \"Har jaa Ali ka khuṅ bahaa\",
    \"Baha Ali ka khuṅ baha\": \"Bahaa Ali ka khuṅ bahaa\",
    \"Haaṅ Zehra ka dulaara hai\": \"Haaṅ Zehra ka dilaara hai\",
    \"Akbar ka ye Baba hai\": \"Akbar ka ye baba hai\",
    \"Ye fahim-e-Quraani\": \"Ye fahm-e-Quraani\",
    \"Ye apna ghar luta chuka\": \"Ye apna ghar lutaa chuka\",
    \"Thama raha data raha\": \"Thama raha dataa raha\",
}
for old, new in fixes.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)

source_lines = body.decode().strip().splitlines()
roman_lines = [line.strip() for line in roman.splitlines()]
assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines)
digits = dict(zip(\"۱۲۳۴\", \"1234\"))
for source, reading in zip(source_lines, roman_lines):
    assert bool(source) == bool(reading)
    if source in digits:
        assert reading == digits[source]

updated = metadata + b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + roman.encode() + b\"\\n---\\n\" + body
path.write_bytes(updated)
assert path.read_bytes().split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1] == body
print(f\"Verified {sum(bool(line) and line not in digits for line in source_lines)} aligned verse lines and unchanged Urdu body.\")
PY"

item.text:
Audited all 79 Roman verse lines against the Urdu source. Corrected phonetic spellings including `yaqiṅ`, `dilaara`, and `fahm`, and removed one extra `Ali` from the first refrain. All stanza boundaries and verse lines align. The Urdu text and metadata are unchanged.

I retained `naazeman` because the pronunciation of `نازمان` is uncertain.
